messages:
anya: Quick check — we need to reorganize the inference perf review this week. Current slot conflicts with infra oncall. Can people pick preferred times?

Options (30–45m):
A) Tue 10:00-10:45 PST / Tue 18:00-18:45 UTC
B) Wed 14:00-14:45 PST / Wed 22:00-22:45 UTC
C) Thu 08:30-09:00 PST (short readout) / Thu 16:30-17:00 UTC

Proposed agenda (rough):
- quick health + incidents (5m)
- benchmark readout: latency P50/P95 and cost deltas (15m)
- optimization proposals: batching/quant changes (10m)
- rollouts & fallback plan (5–10m)
- action items + owners (5m)

Ping me your preference and if you want to present a section.

omar: A or C for me. prefer A if we need deeper discussion.

sasha: B works best. I have a 30m window in B and can present the KV-cache vs no-cache perf slides.

molly: C is safest for me (travel day). If A is chosen, I can dial in but might miss last 5 mins.

anya: Noted — looks split. Quick poll: reply with A/B/C. Also note timezone: I'm in EST so A=13:00 for me.

max: A

omar: A

sasha: B (lean B)

molly: C

anya: tally so far: A=3, B=1, C=1. We can do A if Sasha can still present in that slot? Sasha, any chance to switch?

sasha: I can slide my prep earlier — ok to present in A. I'll compress to 12m with key graphs.

anya: sweet. Agenda tweak: Sasha presents latency/cost overlays (12m), Omar covers batch/quant experiments (12m), Molly does rollout plan (6m). Can we also surface the dashboard link in the thread?

max: here: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/latency?view=week — pull token-level breakdown, P95 grouped by model variant.

anya: adding a short preread: please drop any failing eval prompts into this thread or link to the eval run. We'll track regression risk.

devbot: Calendar invite created: Inference Perf Readout — Tue 10:00 PST — 45m — hosts: anya, sasha.ics_link

anya: quick checklist before the meeting:
- Sasha: export slides + 3 highlight figs into /shared/bench-readouts (pdf)
- Omar: prepare batch/quant perf table + config snippets
- Molly: draft rollback/runbook steps (1 pager)
- Max: confirm dashboard filters + example query

omar: putting config snippet here for visibility:
```
batch_size: dynamic
target_latency_slo_ms: 150
quant: int8-ptq
kv_cache: enabled
```

anya: If anyone needs more than 45m, please say now. Also flag any cross-team invites (sre, infra, product).

molly: SRE should join for rollback signoff — adding @sre on the invite.

max: can we add a tiny pre-call channel note for folks who can't attend with action item assignee? e.g., "If you miss, add notes to the spreadsheet and assign owner"

anya: done — will add to invite. Final: meeting set for 1799991111 -> Tue 10:00 PST (A). See calendar. If anything blocks, DM me. Thanks all. :+1:
